notes.title: Fishing Fest Update
notes.content: [h2]Major Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]The demo wall has been moved further out, granting access to more content[/p][/*][/list][h2]Polish Features[/h2][list][*][p]New art for dock cards[/p][/*][*][p]Art improvements for the dock[/p][/*][*][p]Environmental art improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Improved fish visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Straw Length upgrade unlocked[/p][/*][*][p]Speed Up upgrade unlocked[/p][/*][*][p]More particles[/p][/*][*][p]Fish sipping looks better[/p][/*][*][p]Chests can no longer be opened while completely submerged in water[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]More![/p][/*][/list][p]We recommend [b]resetting your save[/b] to get the full new and improved Sip Fisher experience, though you can always just start where you left off![/p][p][/p][p]The team wants to thank everyone who has left a review on our demo. Your feedback has been crucial in making Sip Fisher better! We will be continuing to fix bugs in the demo until our full release![/p]

notes.title: Bug Fixing [6/13/25]
notes.content: [h1]Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Added the text popup that was supposed to appear when you opened chests[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the broken buoy[/p][/*][*][p]Shopkeeper is no longer reversed[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer get the tutorial chest without sipping[/p][/*][*][p]Settings added for Target Framerate, Vsync, and Brightness[/p][/*][*][p]More effects for fish stunning[/p][/*][*][p]Visual improvements[/p][/*][*][p]And more![/p][/*][/list]
